locator.quote: In the closing formal half-page, label each linked result as the same as,

method_findings.finding: The exposition rule asks the closing half-page to label each linked result, while the short-paper rule asks a one-page appendix to hold a broad model/target/fidelity/reproduction inventory. General routing rules exist, but these specific prescriptions do not state which obligation yields when auxiliary results expand the inventory.
method_findings.why_it_matters: The current exposition’s dense closing paragraph and the companion’s roughly 2.35-page appendix illustrate the tension. This is a source-assisted editorial diagnosis, not demonstrated causal evidence that the skill caused every excess.
method_findings.rule_to_change: Clarify the priority within the existing evidence-routing rule: the short audit route must locally expose the headline theorem and every restriction of its used dependencies; supplementary results may carry a concise relation plus an exact existing destination for the full componentwise comparison. Treat page counts as planning targets, not permission to omit material hypotheses.
method_findings.boundary: Do not hide material restrictions of the theorem used. Only supplementary detail may be routed away.
existing_rules_acknowledged: The skills already require a named reader, one point, page allocation, exact source comparison, omission destinations and bidirectional reconciliation of evidence labels. This recommendation does not duplicate those requirements.

The current method already requires saying what exactly differs. Mixed/incomparable labels can help express that existing requirement.

scope: All three supplied method files were read as review sources. No skill files were edited. The assignment’s advice-only boundaries control this deliverable.
